$comment: Area registry (G6-01, plan section 4/5). Lists every area the `thaivia acquire/build/audit` CLI can operate on via `--area <id>`. This mechanism generalizes the pipeline beyond the single hardcoded th-bkk-pilot-001 area; adding a real 2nd/3rd candidate area is G6-02, not this file's own job. Registering an area here is NOT a coverage or acquisition claim -- see each area's own config for coverage_status/coverage_status_reason.

areas.notes: The original G1-G5 pilot area. Omitting --area (or passing --area th-bkk-pilot-001) must behave identically -- this is the back-compat contract G6-01 preserves.
G6-02 candidate 2nd area, coverage_status UNVERIFIED. Rationale: docs/data/candidate-areas-rationale.md. Real acquisition/audit is G6-03 (blocked, see ADR-0003).

G6-02 candidate 3rd area, coverage_status UNVERIFIED. Rationale: docs/data/candidate-areas-rationale.md. Real acquisition/audit is G6-03 (blocked, see ADR-0003). 3 areas is a scope CEILING (plan sec. 4), not a quota -- shipping fewer than 3 if quality does not clear the bar is an acceptable outcome.
